issue.title: Bug: [HA] Stale custom BFD monitor delete logs error after local endpoint route cleanup

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

During `test_ha_launch_with_no_peer`, Log Analyzer reports an `orchagent` error while deleting a BFD session:

```text
ERR swss#orchagent: :- remove_bfd_session: BFD session for default:default:<IP> does not exist
```

The test itself passed, and the end state has no live BFD session for that key. The failure is a cleanup/logging issue: a delete for a BFD session is received after that session was already removed.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Use SmartSwitch HA setup
2. Run:
```shell
python3 -m pytest ha/test_ha_launch_with_no_peer.py
```
3. Check NPU syslog / Log Analyzer for `remove_bfd_session` errors.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior:

The test function passes, but `orchagent` logs an error during BFD cleanup:

```text
ERR swss#orchagent: :- remove_bfd_session: BFD session for default:default:<IP> does not exist
```

Expected behavior:

No error should be logged

### Relevant log output

```shell
# Previous cycle: VNET route included <IP>, and BFD for <IP> existed.
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.604220|VNET_ROUTE_TUNNEL_TABLE:Vnet_55:<IP>|SET|endpoint:<IP>,<IP>|endpoint_monitor:<IP>,<IP>|primary:<IP>|monitoring:custom_bfd
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.605789|BFD_SESSION_TABLE:default:default:<IP>|SET|local_addr:<IP>|multihop:true|shutdown_bfd_during_tsa:true
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.630979|BFD_SESSION_TABLE|default|default|<IP>|SET|state:Up|local_discriminator:25|local_addr:<IP>

# Previous cycle cleanup: route and both BFD sessions are deleted.
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.320241|VNET_ROUTE_TUNNEL_TABLE:Vnet_55:<IP>|DEL
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.321103|BFD_SESSION_TABLE:default:default:<IP>|DEL
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.321130|BFD_SESSION_TABLE:default:default:<IP>|DEL
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.323328|BFD_SESSION_TABLE|default|default|<IP>|DEL
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.323356|BFD_SESSION_TABLE|default|default|<IP>|DEL

# New cycle starts: route first has only the local endpoint.
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.634202|VNET_ROUTE_TUNNEL_TABLE:Vnet_55:<IP>|SET|endpoint:<IP>|endpoint_monitor:<IP>|primary:<IP>|monitoring:custom_bfd

# Orchagent treats this as a direct/local endpoint, not as an overlay NHG.
2026 Jul  8 <IPV6>.636080 r-bobcat-01 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addRoute: Input <IP>@Vlan55 is not overlay nexthop group
2026 Jul  8 <IPV6>.636214 r-bobcat-01 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- postRouteState: Advertisement of prefix: <IP>/32 with profile: , status: active via prefix: <IP>/32

# New cycle updates to two endpoints, but only <IP> BFD is created.
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.857513|VNET_ROUTE_TUNNEL_TABLE:Vnet_55:<IP>|SET|endpoint:<IP>,<IP>|endpoint_monitor:<IP>,<IP>|primary:<IP>|monitoring:custom_bfd
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.885665|BFD_SESSION_TABLE:default:default:<IP>|SET|local_addr:<IP>|multihop:true|shutdown_bfd_during_tsa:true
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.161354|BFD_SESSION_TABLE|default|default|<IP>|SET|state:Up|local_discriminator:27|local_addr:<IP>

# Route flips primary/monitor ordering to the peer endpoint. Immediately after,
# a stale/late delete for <IP> arrives even though no <IP> BFD
# session was created in this cycle.
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.615926|VNET_ROUTE_TUNNEL_TABLE:Vnet_55:<IP>|SET|endpoint:<IP>,<IP>|endpoint_monitor:<IP>,<IP>|primary:<IP>|monitoring:custom_bfd
2026-07-08.<IPV6>.619587|BFD_SESSION_TABLE:default:default:<IP>|DEL
2026 Jul  8 <IPV6>.619652 r-bobcat-01 ERR swss#orchagent: :- remove_bfd_session: BFD session for default:default:<IP> does not exist
```

## Triage:

The route update at `<IPV6>` did not recreate a BFD session for `<IP>` (Don't know why).

The later `<IPV6>` delete is treated as error since no entry exist

Need to understand VNetOrch why the entry at <IPV6> wouldn't create a BFD session

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell
master
```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

resolution.title: [orchagent]: Recreate custom BFD monitor for reused nexthop
resolution.description:
## What I did

Decouple endpoint monitor setup from next-hop-group creation in `VNetRouteOrch::selectNextHopGroup()`.

A directly connected next-hop group can survive route deletion. When the route was recreated, the existing NHG caused monitor setup to be skipped, so the route owned stale monitor state without recreating its custom BFD session. A later route update then emitted a delete for a session that had never been created in that cycle.

The updated logic recreates route-specific endpoint monitor state whenever either the NHG or route is new, while creating the shared NHG only when needed.

Added a DVS regression that deletes and recreates a local-only custom-BFD route while its directly connected next hop is reused.

## Testing

- `make -C orchagent -j2 orchagent`
- Baseline `test_vnet.py::TestVnetOrch::test_vnet_orch_34`: fails at the second BFD-session check after route recreation
- Fixed `test_vnet.py::TestVnetOrch::test_vnet_orch_34`: passed
- `git diff --check`
- `python3 -m py_compile tests/test_vnet.py`

Fixes sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#28336

### sonic-mgmt validation

Targeted SmartSwitch HA validation used `ha/test_ha_launch_with_no_peer.py::test_ha_launch_with_no_peer` with sonic-mgmt PR #26298 applied.

- Baseline: 3 target custom-BFD session creates and 4 route-cleanup markers reproduced 1 stale `remove_bfd_session` error.
- Fixed orchagent: the same 3 target session creates and 4 route-cleanup markers produced 0 stale session-deletion errors.
- Post-cleanup checks found no residual target BFD session or VNET route entries.
- SWSS, syncd, GNMI, and DASH HA services remained active with zero restarts and no cores.

The issue-specific lifecycle validation passed. The overall pytest result remained non-passing because of an unrelated traffic assertion and Log Analyzer sensor errors.
